Day 11/30 — Memory<T> and ReadOnlySpan<T> Slicing (.NET & C#)

Spotted a hot-path telemetry parser creating millions of string fragments on Gen0 during a recent code review.

• **Memory Traffic:** string.Substring allocates a brand new object on the managed heap every single time.
• **Stack Safety:** ReadOnlySpan references existing memory safely without triggering garbage collector pressure.
• **Slicing Mechanics:** Slices operate via stack-allocated pointers with zero allocation overhead.

Watch out: You cannot store a Span inside an async method state machine because spans cannot cross an await boundary.

How do you handle binary protocol parsing in your hot paths?
